Everything new in C++26 

What’s coming in C++26? In this video, we dive into the latest features, improvements, and proposals currently shaping the future of the C++ programming language. From language enhancements to standard library updates, discover what you need to know to stay ahead in C++.

Whether you are a professional software engineer or a student learning C++, understanding the evolution of the language is essential for writing modern, efficient, and safe code. We break down the most significant changes expected in the C++26 standard.

Topics covered:
- Overview of the C++26 standardization process
- Key language features and syntax updates
- Standard library enhancements
- Performance improvements and future-proofing your code
